swarmConfig.name: MarketingScan AI Audit Swarm
swarmConfig.description: 8-agent hierarchical swarm for comprehensive marketing audits

agents.name: Customer Insights Analyst
agents.role: Analyze target audience, competitors, and market positioning

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Customer insights analysis'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-1-insights' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/insights/analysis'

agents.name: SEO Optimizer
agents.role: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, keywords, backlinks analysis

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'SEO audit analysis'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-2-seo' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/seo/audit'

agents.name: CRO Specialist
agents.role: Conversion rate optimization, funnel audit, UX analysis

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'CRO and UX audit'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-2-cro' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/cro/audit'

agents.name: Content Strategist
agents.role: Content gap analysis, quality assessment, editorial calendar

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Content strategy audit'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-2-content' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/content/audit'

agents.name: Paid Search Manager
agents.role: Google Ads audit, search campaign opportunities

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Paid search audit'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-3-paid-search' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/paid-search/audit'

agents.name: Paid Social Manager
agents.role: Social ads audit, platform recommendations (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Paid social audit'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-3-paid-social' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/paid-social/audit'

agents.name: Brand Strategist
agents.role: Brand positioning, messaging, visual identity audit

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Brand strategy audit'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-3-brand' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --memory-key 'swarm/brand/audit'

agents.name: Analytics Specialist
agents.role: Synthesize all audits, calculate scores, prioritize recommendations

hooks.pre: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-task --description 'Final report synthesis'
hooks.post: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-task --task-id 'stage-4-analytics' && npx claude-flow@alpha hooks session-end --export-metrics true
